metadata.definition: por repo × mes (mes de created_at): created = beads creados; started/closed = con started_at/closed_at dentro de la cohorte; lead_time = closed_at − started_at en minutos para beads con ambos, p50 exacto; completeness = lead_time_n / closed. Fuente: .beads/issues.jsonl de cada repo (bd no-db).

reasons.reopened: no event log in no-db mode
reasons.excluded: repos fuera del filtro charly (FPA-141): conteo de issues, sin texto
